def record_agent_session_interruption_incident(
    *,
    incident_id: str,
    interrupted_session_id: str,
    base_head_sha: str,
    checkpoint_ref: str,
    prepared_paths: list[str] | tuple[str, ...] = (),
    authorization_id: str | None = None,
    interrupted_command_class: str = "SESSION_INTERRUPTED",
    remediation_channel: str = "gate_chain_publisher.submit",
    status: str = "RECORDED",
    state_root: Path | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Record a transversal, secret-free agent session interruption incident in canonical maintenance storage."""
    root = Path(os.environ.get("EDARSAHUB_ROOT", "/app"))
    qroot = state_root or (root / ".git" / "universal-worker-queue")
    log_path = qroot / "maintenance" / SESSION_INTERRUPTION_INCIDENTS_FILENAME
    log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    record: dict[str, Any] = {
        "schema": SCHEMA_SESSION_INTERRUPTION,
        "incident_id": str(incident_id or "").strip(),
        "incident_class": "AGENT_SESSION_INTERRUPTION",
        "scope": "TRANSVERSAL",
        "interrupted_session_id": str(interrupted_session_id or "").strip(),
        "recorded_at_utc": utc_now(),
        "base_head_sha": str(base_head_sha or "").strip(),
        "checkpoint_ref": str(checkpoint_ref or "").strip(),
        "prepared_paths": sorted({str(p).strip().lstrip("./") for p in prepared_paths if str(p).strip()}),
        "authorization_id": str(authorization_id or "").strip() or None,
        "interrupted_command_class": str(interrupted_command_class or "SESSION_INTERRUPTED").strip(),
        "remediation_channel": str(remediation_channel or "gate_chain_publisher.submit").strip(),
        "non_destructive_preservation": True,
        "status": str(status or "RECORDED").strip().upper(),
        "production_touched": False,
    }
    if not record["incident_id"]:
        raise ValueError("SESSION_INTERRUPTION_INCIDENT_ID_REQUIRED")
    with log_path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    return record


def list_agent_session_interruption_incidents(
    *,
    state_root: Path | None = None,
    limit: int = 25,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Return most recent transversal agent session interruption incidents (deduplicated by incident_id)."""
    root = Path(os.environ.get("EDARSAHUB_ROOT", "/app"))
    qroot = state_root or (root / ".git" / "universal-worker-queue")
    log_path = qroot / "maintenance" / SESSION_INTERRUPTION_INCIDENTS_FILENAME
    if not log_path.is_file():
        return []
    by_id: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    try:
        lines = log_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    except OSError:
        return []
    for raw in lines:
        raw = raw.strip()
        if not raw:
            continue
        try:
            item = json.loads(raw)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        iid = str(item.get("incident_id") or "").strip()
        if iid:
            by_id[iid] = item
    ordered = sorted(
        by_id.values(),
        key=lambda x: str(x.get("recorded_at_utc") or ""),
        reverse=True,
    )
    return ordered[: max(1, int(limit))]


def evaluate_interrupted_objective_recovery(
    *,
    domain: str,
    checkpoint_path: Path,
    prepared_paths: list[str] | tuple[str, ...] = (),
    base_sha: str | None = None,
    production_allowed: bool = False,
    repo_root: Path | None = None,
    state_root: Path | None = None,
    now_utc: datetime | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Evaluate fail-closed automatic recovery eligibility of an interrupted objective from persistent checkpoint + materialized authorization."""
    root = repo_root or Path(os.environ.get("EDARSAHUB_ROOT", "/app"))
    qroot = state_root or (root / ".git" / "universal-worker-queue")
    norm_domain = str(domain or "").strip().upper()
    norm_paths = sorted({str(p).strip().lstrip("./") for p in prepared_paths if str(p).strip()})

    if production_allowed is not False:
        return {
            "schema": SCHEMA_INTERRUPTED_RECOVERY_EVAL,
            "recoverable": False,
            "action": "BLOCK_PRODUCTION_FORBIDDEN",
            "reason": "PRODUCTION_FORBIDDEN",
            "remediation_channel": "NONE",
            "production_touched": False,
        }
    if not checkpoint_path.is_file():
        return {
            "schema": SCHEMA_INTERRUPTED_RECOVERY_EVAL,
            "recoverable": False,
            "action": "ESCALATE_CHECKPOINT_MISSING",
            "reason": "PERSISTENT_CHECKPOINT_MISSING",
            "remediation_channel": "HUMAN_AUDIT",
            "production_touched": False,
        }

    auth = resolve_active_domain_authorization(
        norm_domain,
        state_root=qroot,
        required_class="DEVELOPMENT_MUTATION",
        requested_paths=norm_paths or None,
        now_utc=now_utc,
    )
    if not auth:
        return {
            "schema": SCHEMA_INTERRUPTED_RECOVERY_EVAL,
            "recoverable": False,
            "action": "ESCALATE_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED",
            "reason": "ACTIVE_GATE_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED",
            "domain": norm_domain,
            "prepared_paths": norm_paths,
            "remediation_channel": "HUMAN_GO_REQUIRED",
            "production_touched": False,
        }

    # Check base drift on prepared paths when base_sha is provided
    drifted_paths: list[str] = []
    if base_sha and norm_paths:
        changed = _git_diff_names_between(root, base_sha, "HEAD")
        if changed is None:
            return {
                "schema": SCHEMA_INTERRUPTED_RECOVERY_EVAL,
                "recoverable": False,
                "action": "ESCALATE_BASE_UNVERIFIABLE",
                "reason": "CHECKPOINT_BASE_NOT_ANCESTOR",
                "domain": norm_domain,
                "remediation_channel": "HUMAN_AUDIT",
                "production_touched": False,
            }
        drifted_paths = sorted(changed & set(norm_paths))
        if drifted_paths:
            return {
                "schema": SCHEMA_INTERRUPTED_RECOVERY_EVAL,
                "recoverable": False,
                "action": "ESCALATE_SCOPE_DRIFT",
                "reason": "PREPARED_PATHS_DRIFTED_SINCE_INTERRUPTION",
                "domain": norm_domain,
                "drifted_paths": drifted_paths,
                "remediation_channel": "REBASE_ON_CANONICAL_HEAD",
                "production_touched": False,
            }

    return {
        "schema": SCHEMA_INTERRUPTED_RECOVERY_EVAL,
        "recoverable": True,
        "action": "RECOVER_VIA_CANONICAL_PUBLISHER",
        "reason": "CHECKPOINT_AND_AUTHORIZATION_VERIFIED",
        "domain": norm_domain,
        "authorization_id": auth.get("authorization_id"),
        "gate_id": auth.get("gate_id"),
        "prepared_paths": norm_paths,
        "remediation_channel": "gate_chain_publisher.submit",
        "direct_push_allowed": False,
        "destructive_git_allowed": False,
        "production_touched": False,
    }

def test_07_agent_session_interruption_incident_and_checkpoint_recovery(tmp_path):
    repo, sha1 = _init_git_repo(tmp_path)
    qroot = _setup_queue(repo)
    ckpt = repo / "MCP_CHECKPOINT.md"
    ckpt.write_text("WORKSTREAM=EDARSAHUB_MCP_RECOVERY\nSTATUS=IN_PROGRESS\n", encoding="utf-8")

    # 1. Verify worker_control_plane.py uses 65s backend readiness window & 15s MCP wait
    wcp_src = (REPO_ROOT / "tools" / "mirror_sync" / "worker_control_plane.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "deadline = time.time() + 65.0" in wcp_src
    assert "mcp_deadline = time.time() + 15.0" in wcp_src

    # 2. Record transversal agent session interruption incident
    rec = lr.record_agent_session_interruption_incident(
        incident_id="AGENT-SESSION-INTERRUPTION-TEST-001",
        interrupted_session_id="41f7a06c-test",
        base_head_sha=sha1,
        checkpoint_ref="docs/agent-governance/checkpoints/MCP_UNIVERSAL_WORKER.md",
        prepared_paths=["a.py"],
        authorization_id="GO-TEST-SESSION-RECOVERY",
        interrupted_command_class="DIRECT_PUSH_STOPPED_BY_GOVERNANCE_POLICY",
        state_root=qroot,
    )
    assert rec["schema"] == lr.SCHEMA_SESSION_INTERRUPTION
    assert rec["scope"] == "TRANSVERSAL"
    assert rec["remediation_channel"] == "gate_chain_publisher.submit"
    assert rec["production_touched"] is False

    # 3. Surfaced non-blockingly in global lifecycle scanner
    det = lr.scan_global_lifecycle_blockers(
        repo_root=repo,
        state_root=qroot,
        claims_dir=repo / ".git" / "agent-guard" / "state" / "claims",
        attestations_dir=repo / ".git" / "mirror-sync" / "reporting" / "test_attestations",
        force_full=True,
        remote_inbox_ids=set(),
        remote_result_ids=set(),
    )
    assert len(det["agent_session_interruption_incidents"]) == 1
    assert det["agent_session_interruption_incidents"][0]["incident_id"] == "AGENT-SESSION-INTERRUPTION-TEST-001"

    # 4. Fail-closed in Production and without materialized authorization
    prod_blocked = lr.evaluate_interrupted_objective_recovery(
        domain="WORKER_CONTROL_PLANE",
        checkpoint_path=ckpt,
        prepared_paths=["a.py"],
        base_sha=sha1,
        production_allowed=True,
        repo_root=repo,
        state_root=qroot,
    )
    assert prod_blocked["recoverable"] is False
    assert prod_blocked["reason"] == "PRODUCTION_FORBIDDEN"

    unauth = lr.evaluate_interrupted_objective_recovery(
        domain="WORKER_CONTROL_PLANE",
        checkpoint_path=ckpt,
        prepared_paths=["a.py"],
        base_sha=sha1,
        repo_root=repo,
        state_root=qroot,
    )
    assert unauth["recoverable"] is False
    assert unauth["reason"] == "ACTIVE_GATE_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED"

    # 5. With active materialized authorization -> ready for canonical gate_chain_publisher.submit() handoff
    lr.materialize_gate_authorization(
        gate_id="SESSION-RECOVERY-TEST",
        authorization_id="GO-TEST-SESSION-RECOVERY",
        granted_by="ricardo@edarsa.com.mx",
        domains=["WORKER_CONTROL_PLANE"],
        allowed_paths=["a.py"],
        state_root=qroot,
    )
    ok = lr.evaluate_interrupted_objective_recovery(
        domain="WORKER_CONTROL_PLANE",
        checkpoint_path=ckpt,
        prepared_paths=["a.py"],
        base_sha=sha1,
        repo_root=repo,
        state_root=qroot,
    )
    assert ok["recoverable"] is True
    assert ok["action"] == "RECOVER_VIA_CANONICAL_PUBLISHER"
    assert ok["remediation_channel"] == "gate_chain_publisher.submit"
    assert ok["direct_push_allowed"] is False
    assert ok["destructive_git_allowed"] is False
    assert ok["production_touched"] is False
